question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right back, Bob is playing goalkeeper, Claire is playing left midfielder, Dave is playing left back, and Eve is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Alice trade positions. Then, Dave and Alice trade positions. Then, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Claire and Dave trade positions. Finally, Eve and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) right back
(B) goalkeeper
(C) left midfielder
(D) left back
(E) right winger
solution:
Positions in order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve):
Initial: (right back, goalkeeper, left midfielder, left back, right winger)
1. Eve and Alice swap: (right winger, goalkeeper, left midfielder, left back, right back)
2. Dave and Alice swap: (left back, goalkeeper, left midfielder, right winger, right back)
3. Claire and Alice swap: (left midfielder, goalkeeper, left back, right winger, right back)
4. Claire and Dave swap: (left midfielder, goalkeeper, right winger, left back, right back)
5. Eve and Claire swap: (left midfielder, goalkeeper, right back, left back, right winger)
Alice plays left midfielder, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
